svg.aria-label: SolarLights Lite hookup diagram with the 5 V camera panel: panel through a single 1N5819 Schottky into the TP4056 module, cells on B plus and B minus, OUT plus and OUT minus rails feeding the Arduino Pro Mini, the MOSFET LED driver and the Wemos D1 Mini.
svg.text: SolarLights Lite – hookup with the 5 V (“10 W”) camera panel
one diode only – omit it if the panel
already has its own blocking diode
CHRG = IC pin 7 = red LED cathode
One Schottky, not two silicon diodes. 2 × 1N4001 drop ~1.7 V at 0.7 A;
5 V − 1.7 V = 3.3 V at IN+ and the pack never reaches 4.2 V.
No over-voltage guard needed: Voc 6.2 V (6.7 V cold) is well under the
TP4056's 8 V limit, so the diode is only there to block night reverse flow.
Divider R1/R2 unchanged – 1.66 V max at A0.
Charge current self-limits at ~0.7 A (0.35 A per cell). TP4056 heat
≈ 0.6 W – mount the module where air moves.
Q1 must be logic-level. IRFZ34N is a 10 V-gate part: worst-case Vgs(th)
is 4 V, above the 3.3 V drive, and threshold rises as it gets colder.
Harvest ≈ 1,350 mAh/day in June vs 560 mAh/day used at Stage 2.
PV – panel positive, before the diode
